issues_in: SKILL.md line 9 location text ("South Dakota location south of 57th Street and west of S. Dubuque Avenue") contradicts data.json location ("South of E. Rice St. and east of Veterans Pkwy")
fixed: Corrected SKILL.md location bullet to the source-backed location "South of E. Rice St. and east of Veterans Pkwy (northeast Sioux Falls, between Sioux Falls and Brandon)", removed the erroneous "south of 57th Street and west of S. Dubuque Avenue" text, and aligned the acreage note with the official Planning Commission staff report figure of 164 acres (some media write ~160); data.json location was confirmed correct and left unchanged
Added a dated 2026-08-11 fix-pass note to NOTES.md documenting the SKILL.md location correction with source URLs (official amv.siouxfalls.gov staff report PDF, KELOLAND, Des Moines Register)
remaining_risks: KELOLAND returns HTTP 403 to non-browser clients (bot protection) and desmoinesregister returns a 302 redirect via curl; both were returned as live results by web search and are cited only as corroborating sources, not primary evidence
The primary official location source (amv.siouxfalls.gov staff report PDF) returned HTTP 200 and is already in data.json sources
SKILL.md was edited because the review issue explicitly targets its location text; parent should review the corrected wording
data.json was not modified in this pass; all its fields (including evidence_grade, contradictions, history) were already consistent with the issue list
summary: Resolved the single review issue: SKILL.md's location text ("south of 57th Street and west of S. Dubuque Avenue") contradicted data.json's source-backed location. A targeted web check (KELOLAND, Des Moines Register, official staff report PDF) confirmed data.json's "South of E. Rice St. and east of Veterans Pkwy" is correct, so SKILL.md was corrected to match and the fix was documented in NOTES.md with source URLs. data.json remained valid JSON and was otherwise untouched.
